prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Tutorial: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split layout showcasing interactive desktop shortcut highlights for calling, hiding, and speaking to the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "body": "Learn how to easily summon, hide, and interact with your pet on your desktop."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Desktop Display Pre-Check Screen: Insert a pre-check screen before pet selection to test display scaling and desktop rendering compatibility.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_display_check", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_display_check": {"headline": "Checking Desktop Compatibility", "body": "We are verifying screen settings to ensure your desktop pet renders cleanly.", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [home, new_flow] Pet Playbook Mini-Game While Waiting: Introduce an interactive pet training mini-flow on the waiting screen while the 3D pet model is generated.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Your Pet is Being Created!", "body": "While you wait, explore quick mini-activities to learn how to care for your pet.", "layout": "stage", "notify_when_ready": true}}
3: [choose_path, reorder] Streamlined Path First Entry: Reorder onboarding so users pick their onboarding path immediately before reading the full background story.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery & Sync Notice: Add clear copy explaining that signing in anchors pet progress to prevent data resets across logins.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet", "body": "Log in to link your pet to your account and keep progress synced across sessions.", "hint": "Use your primary account so your pet data is safely backed up."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Step-by-Step Generation Status Tracker: Show granular progress indicators and estimated time remaining during pet rendering on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Generating Your Pet", "body": "Assembling 3D animations and desktop behaviors...", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Official Pet Adoption Milestone Badge: Display a celebratory adoption certificate card with an official badge when completing pet naming.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Congratulations! Your new companion is officially adopted and ready for setup.", "layout": "card"}}
7: [adoption, layout] Split-Screen Pet Selection Layout: Switch the pick_friend screen layout to split-screen to showcase full pet previews alongside choice options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Companion", "body": "Preview pet behaviors and animations side-by-side to make your choice."}}
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Notification & Quick Summon Setup: Prompt users on the finish screen to enable desktop tray notifications and hotkeys for fast pet access.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet is Ready on Desktop!", "body": "Enable system tray shortcuts so your pet is always accessible with one click.", "notify_when_ready": true}}
9: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Quality Guidelines & Validator: Add photo selection guidelines and explicit tips to ensure uploaded images produce high-quality pets.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Pet Photos", "body": "For the best render, use clear, well-lit photos facing forward.", "hint": "Avoid dark or blurry images so your pet model renders cleanly."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a new technical compatibility screen inside onboarding without removing required steps is allowed.
Adding mini-activities during the wait while preserving the pet creation notice is allowed.
Reordering onboarding steps while keeping all required screens is permitted.
Adding explanatory copy to the sign-in screen is allowed.
Showing progress and time estimates during a real wait is allowed under Rule 5.
Replacing the required official stamp with a milestone badge loses the job/element required on the adoption certificate.
Redesigning the pick_friend screen layout to split-screen is allowed.
Adding desktop notification settings to the home intro screen during onboarding is allowed.
Adding photo upload quality hints on the upload_photos screen is allowed.
